Full implementation-sufficient reference justified because MDN's rel='compression-dictionary' page is two paragraphs without crossorigin/referrerpolicy/destination details and MDN's Request.destination omits 'compression-dictionary'. Maps all three Chrome 156 updates across all 9 dimensions.

Distinguishes Chrome 156 catch-up updates (noting ChromeStatus desktop_first=156 and null Android/WebView fields) from Chrome 130 base CDT, Firefox 145 behind pref / preview, and Safari unshipped.

Every visible source and citation label carries a direct external <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; all 3 CPS concept URLs, CPS feature root, and CPS conformance HTML/JSON HEAD-checked 200 on 2026-11-27; feature-root links marked data-demo-rel='related' so link-request-semantics/ is cleanly selected.
